_comment: Curated list of documentation ↔ code pairs. This is the only part that changes over time — add pages where drift actually hurts (reference schemas, not prose). Keep the scope NARROW: internal/manifest as a whole yields 139 candidates and nobody opens that report; internal/manifest/schema.go yields 18 and those can be read.

pairs.why: Reference schema of the Workspace manifest. As of 2026-08-06 it did not know files:, composio or notification_channels.
Described a feature-registry allowlist that does not exist in the code.

Routine DSL. Promises the JSON can be copied into kind: Routine without changing semantics. The WIDEST pair — types.go holds the whole DSL, the page only part of it, so it yields ~100 candidates. Candidate for narrowing.
Agent fields — the provider/cli_adapter/tool_profile enums move with the model catalogue.
Crew + files: delivery of shared files.
Second reference page of the same schema — tends to be more current than the one under configuration/.
